THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.title: The King's Servant
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.INITI:
A cloaked figure steps from the shadows, blocking your path. He bows deeply — a servant of the [purple]King[/purple].

[sine][gold]“I have been sent to find those who would prove themselves.”[/gold][/sine]

He produces a [gold]scroll[/gold] of pale pink, sealed with the King's sigil.

[sine][gold]“A summons. Deeper in the Spire, the King's [purple]Champion[/purple] awaits all who would seek audience. Best him, and the path to the King opens.”[/gold][/sine]
Gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] Max HP. [red]Downgrade[/red] a random card.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.ACCEP:
You take the scroll. It is warm to the touch, as though the King's will pulses within it.

The servant nods.

[sine][gold]“Carry it deeper. The [purple]Champion[/purple] keeps vigil at the warrior's resting place — there your worth will be measured. Do not lose it.”[/gold][/sine]

He bows once more and vanishes into the shadows.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.OFFER:
You draw a blade across your palm. [jitter][red]Blood[/red][/jitter] drips onto the stone floor.

The servant watches without expression. As the pain subsides, clarity washes over you — a technique you once struggled with now feels [b]effortless[/b].

[sine][gold]“The King accepts your offering.”[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.DECLI:
You lower your gaze. The servant's eyes soften briefly.

[sine][gold]“Your humility grants you mercy. But what you have not earned, I shall take back.”[/gold][/sine]

A [green][jitter]jolt of vitality[/jitter][/green] courses through you as a [purple]technique you once mastered[/purple] slips from your grasp. The servant is gone.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.title: The King's Throne Room
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.I:
You stand at the threshold of a vast throne room. Pillars of [b]obsidian[/b] rise toward a ceiling lost in shadow.

At its far end, upon a throne of [sine][gold]black iron[/gold][/sine], sits the King — ageless, silent, [jitter]watching[/jitter].

His gaze falls upon you like a weight. He speaks without moving his lips.

[sine][gold]“Few stand where you stand. State your purpose.”[/gold][/sine]
Present [gold]King's Invitation[/gold]. Enter the King's chambers.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.E:
The invitation dissolves in your hand as you step forward. The King regards you from his throne.

[sine][gold]“You have answered my call. Now — what would you ask of the King?”[/gold][/sine]
Lose [red]{SultanMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Replace [gold]Mardan Fu Mardan's Ring[/gold] with [gold]Sultan's Ring[/gold].
Remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards. Choose a [gold]Rare[/gold] card from any character.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.C:
The King [jitter][b]rises[/b][/jitter]. The room [jitter][red]trembles[/red][/jitter].

[sine][gold]“You have carried [purple]Mardan's[/purple] burden long enough. Yield it, and I shall remake it as it was meant to be.”[/gold][/sine]

He extends a hand — and the [gold]ring[/gold] upon your finger [jitter]reshapes itself[/jitter], the [purple]ancient[/purple] metal singing with [orange]new hunger[/orange] as it becomes something [b]greater[/b].

[sine][gold]“Wield it as it was meant to be wielded.”[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.T:
The King raises a hand. Behind the throne, a [b]great iron door[/b] [jitter]grinds open[/jitter], revealing a [gold]vault[/gold] heaped with [purple]ancient curiosities[/purple].

[sine][gold]“The Spire surrenders many treasures to me. Take what you can carry.”[/gold][/sine]

You step into the vault. [jitter][gold]Three relics[/gold][/jitter] catch your eye, each humming with [purple]power[/purple]. You gather them — and on your way out, scoop a generous handful of [gold]gold coins[/gold] from a spilled chest. You step back before the throne.

[sine][gold]“The King provides for those he favors.”[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.A:
[sine][gold]“Power demands sacrifice,”[/gold][/sine] the King intones.

Cards lift from your deck unbidden, dissolving into [purple]motes of light[/purple]. In their place, knowledge of a [gold]rare and potent technique[/gold] settles into your mind.

[sine][gold]“Use it wisely. There will be no second gift.”[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.R:
The King studies you a long moment, then [sine][gold]“Lay your tools before me.”[/gold][/sine]

You spread your deck across the polished stone. His gaze passes over each card in turn — and where his eye lingers, the parchment [jitter][gold]gleams[/gold][/jitter], the ink [purple]deepens[/purple], the edges [b]sharpen[/b].

[sine][gold]“What is yours, I shall make worthy of my service.”[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-MARDANS_TRIAL.title: Mardan's Trial
THEKINGSDECREE-MARDANS_TRIAL.pages.INITI:
You arrive at the warrior's resting place. A [b]tattered banner of black iron[/b] stands at the foot of a weathered stone sarcophagus, and the air hangs heavy with [purple]old reverence[/purple].

Footsteps echo behind you. The [purple]King's Champion[/purple] approaches — flail across his shoulders, helm bowed, eyes [jitter]fixed upon you[/jitter]. He has been waiting.

He does not speak. He does not need to. The [sine][gold]King's will[/gold][/sine] presses upon you all the same: prove yourself, or pay another price.
THEKINGSDECREE-MARDANS_TRIAL.pages.BARGA:
The Champion regards you a long moment. There is no contempt in his gaze — only the weariness of one who has seen many choose this path before.

He nods once and lays the [gold]ring[/gold] in your palm without ceremony. The metal is warm, heavier than it looks.

As your fingers close around it, a [jitter][red]chill[/red][/jitter] settles into your bones — the [red]King's Curse[/red], paid in advance for what you have not earned.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.P:
You approach the threshold empty-handed and speak your case. The King listens, unmoving. Then, almost imperceptibly, he gestures you forward.

[sine][gold]“An uninvited guest. Speak, while I am in a listening mood.”[/gold][/sine]

You approach the threshold empty-handed. The King does not speak — but you [jitter][red]feel[/red][/jitter] his displeasure.

[sine][gold]You were not invited.[/gold][/sine]
